verdict.rationale: Apple's own runtimes document support for this silicon: MLX is an ML framework built for Apple silicon with a unified memory model, and Apple's Metal/ML developer stack documents PyTorch GPU backends and Metal 4 GPU Neural Accelerators. Coverage is not complete because the support is documented for Apple silicon in general, not for M4 Max specifically, and nothing documents the Neural Engine (NPU) as a runtime target. missing for 10: M4 Max–specific runtime support documentation, documented NPU/Neural Engine targeting by a local-AI runtime, evidence for llama.cpp or ONNX Runtime, independent hands-on corroboration of local inference.

support.subject: As a developer, mainstream local-AI runtimes target this silicon — llama.cpp, MLX, ONNX Runtime, or the vendor's own AI software stack document support for its CPU, GPU, or NPU

citations.quote: MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon, brought to you by Apple machine learning research.
Arrays in MLX live in shared memory. Operations on MLX arrays can be performed on any of the supported device types without transferring data.
Accelerate the training of machine learning models in third-party frameworks right on your Mac with PyTorch backends.
It supports Metal 4 and GPU Neural Accelerators for maximum performance
